title: Emergency Vehicle Detection
description: Detect ambulances, fire trucks, and police cars in an image.
long_description: This project allows you to train a YOLO-based model to identify the presence of ambulances, fire trucks, and police cars in an image/video. This model is suitable for autonomous driving and smart city traffic management applications.
